title: Kali Governance Metadata v1.0
description: Governance metadata required for deterministic evaluation by governance engines.

governance_version.description: Version of the governance pack or engine used.

engine.description: Governance engine identifier (e.g., kali, cage, rego, lula).

role.description: Role performing governance evaluation (e.g., reviewer, approver, auditor).

capabilities.description: Capabilities required or exercised by this governance decision.

reason.description: Optional human-readable justification for the governance decision.

evidence.description: Optional structured evidence used in governance evaluation.
